source: I world where freinds can build turrets with you to defend your base from zombies

answers.ask: Post-apocalyptic was inferred from the zombies - should it be grim and ruined, or bright and cartoonish?
answers.answer: Use a bright, cartoonish zombie-defense look so it stays approachable and fun for friends building together.

answers.ask: Do the waves ever stop - is this survive-N-waves, or endless until the base falls?
answers.answer: Make it endless waves until the base falls, with friends trying to survive as long as possible.

blob:
## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: Post-apocalyptic was inferred from the zombies - should it be grim and ruined, or bright and cartoonish? A: Use a bright, cartoonish zombie-defense look so it stays approachable and fun for friends building together.
- [author] goal — Q: Do the waves ever stop - is this survive-N-waves, or endless until the base falls? A: Make it endless waves until the base falls, with friends trying to survive as long as possible.
- [agent_inferred] zombie approaches — Q: From how many directions do zombies enter the shared defense field? A: Use four evenly spaced perimeter origins so the central base must be defended from every side.

## Enriched image prompt
Build a bright cartoonish cooperative zombie-defense world as one open contested field. Place one shared core base at the centre and surround it with a broad, continuous buildable defensive ring where friends can construct turrets together. Keep the terrain open enough for zombies to path dynamically toward the base from four evenly spaced perimeter entry areas, with no hard-coded lane. Make the central base the dominant landmark and clearly separate the inner turret-building ground from the outer zombie approach ground. Use approachable colorful shapes and playful zombie-defense dressing rather than grim ruins.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Strategy because players cooperatively place turrets to defend a base from endless enemy waves.

## Shape and preset
Use `terrain-open`: zombies path dynamically across open ground from the perimeter toward one central base instead of following a fixed track. The matched preset is Base Defense, extended with shared territorial turret-placement ground.

## Config requirements
Draw the visible half of `tracker-core` as one sturdy central base representing the team's shared health. Use `buildzone-plot` for the broad cooperative turret-building ring radiating around that base. Keep four clear outer approach sectors for the zombie origins without turning them into narrow lanes.

## Layout requirements
Place one `tracker-core` Tracker on the central base. Place four `spawner-npc` Spawners at evenly spaced points around the outer perimeter, all targeting the central base across open terrain. Turret construction behavior and endless-wave timing are mechanics; the visible buildable ring supplies their spatial footprint.

## Layout components
The build contains one central core base, one continuous cooperative build zone around it, one outer approach field, and four evenly distributed zombie entry areas at the boundary. There are no fixed enemy lanes, private plots, or separate maps. Keep radial paths clear enough for dynamic navigation while giving friends room to build several defensive layers. Compose the entire field around the central base so every approach direction is visible.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: the central base, continuous build ring, and four balanced approach sectors must be spatially clear before the cartoon dressing.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale band is medium because the shared base, turret-building ring, and four enemy origins must all remain readable in one frame. The theme is bright, colorful, cartoon zombie defense. The pipeline uses `P0`: all play occurs on one open surface with dynamic pathing and no structurally fixed enemy lane.
